name: Business History Short

visual_language.motion: clean editorial motion with punchy transitions on decision beats
visual_language.captions: single-line when possible; support numbers and names
visual_language.color: neutral editorial palette with brand-aware accents

preferred_sources: official company pages for logos/product references
Library of Congress for older context
asset_strategy.generated_visual_policy: Use for abstract market scenes only; avoid fake product or founder evidence.

sound.sfx: small ticks, paper, camera, notification, and chart cues
sound.mix_rule: numbers and names must stay intelligible

qc: claims about revenue, market share, dates, and people are sourced
logos/trademarks are used only where allowed or replaced with neutral text
brand colors do not override readability
ending states the decision consequence clearly
